name: CloudKilat VPS
line: Rent a KVM virtual server with root access and SSD storage.

work.math: Known VPS subtotal is IDR 90,000 a month. 100 GB of transfer is not metered, under fair use. Tax and the domain are not included.
The XXS plan meets the minimum of 1 vCPU and 1 GB. The known VM subtotal is IDR 90,000 a month. There is no request meter, and transfer is under fair use.
IDR 720,000 for the VM + IDR 50,000 for 20 GB of Protect storage = IDR 770,000 partial subtotal. Whether daily 7-day backups fit is not verified.
